claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (abstract only). The abstract claims that a two-stage predictor, a GAN for a low-resolution layout plus an SRGAN for refinement, trained on many TO runs, estimates conductive heat-transfer topologies accurately in negligible computational time; no numbers are given.
